description: Behavioral evals for the HoloHub Flow Benchmark wrapper. Tests measure-vs-verify mode selection, contract use, and performance-only scope.

evals.prompt: Benchmark the multiai_ultrasound HoloHub app with the greedy scheduler and report latency metrics only.
evals.expected_output: The agent sets HOLOHUB_BENCHMARK_APP, HOLOHUB_BENCHMARK_SCHEDULERS=greedy, leaves HOLOHUB_BENCHMARK_CONTRACT unset, and runs the flow benchmark wrapper.
assertions: the command leaves contract unset for measure mode
the final answer reports latency metrics as performance evidence only
the agent does NOT claim model-output detection or segmentation quality

evals.prompt: Verify endoscopy_tool_tracking latency and operator sequence against its flow benchmark contract.
evals.expected_output: The agent sets HOLOHUB_BENCHMARK_CONTRACT to contracts/endoscopy_tool_tracking.yaml and uses verify mode through the same wrapper.
assertions: the command sets HOLOHUB_BENCHMARK_CONTRACT to the endoscopy contract
the command requests the expected scheduler set or explains the chosen set
the agent reports pass/fail per contract assertion
the agent preserves the performance-only scope

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has measure/verify mode semantics and env var surface from SKILL.md.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent may run the app normally instead of the benchmark build or conflate benchmark logs with quality metrics.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: benchmark build, parsed flow metrics, contract assertions when requested. without_skill: higher instrumentation and scope mistakes.
